University of Melbourne, Dr Betty Elliott Horticulture Scholarship 2022 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia for students undertaking postgraduate research in the discipline of sustainability in horticulture. The scholarship aims to provide financial assistance to graduate students with outstanding academic ability undertaking research into sustainability in horticulture. The selected students will receive a single payment of up to AUD 3,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Be undertaking postgraduate research in the discipline of sustainability in horticulture
The selected candidates will receive a single payment of up to AUD 3,000
